Generated Narrative: StructureDefinition EHDSMedication

NameFlagsCard.TypeDescription & Constraints
EHDSMedication 0..*BaseMedication model
EHDSMedication.identifyingCode[x] 0..*An identifier or a code for the product (virtual product, branded product or package). If several identifiers are specified, they shall not have conflicting meanings or very different granularities. An identifier may not exist, e.g., for substance-based prescriptions.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: SNOMED GPS, EMA PMS ID or a national coding system
EHDSMedication.identifyingCode[x].identifyingCodeCodeableConceptCodeableConcept
EHDSMedication.identifyingCode[x].identifyingCodeIdentifierIdentifier
EHDSMedication.classification 0..*CodeableConceptAnatomical therapeutic chemical classification or another classification (e.g. narcotic/psychotropic, orphan drug).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: WHO ATC, non-binding coding systems for other classifications
EHDSMedication.productName 0..1stringCurrent trade name (authorised name) of the product. When medication is specified by a CodeableConcept, the name may be omitted when available as the display name of the concept.
EHDSMedication.marketingAuthorisationHolder 0..1BaseMarketing authorisation holder of the medicinal product. Relevant for identifying the exact medicinal product. If the medicinal product does not have a marketing authorisation, the manufacturer information may be used.
EHDSMedication.marketingAuthorisationHolder.organisationName 0..1stringName of the organisation holding the authorisation for marketing/manufacturing.
EHDSMedication.marketingAuthorisationHolder.organisationIdentifier 0..*IdentifierIdentifier of the organisation, its physical location or both.
EHDSMedication.doseForm 0..1CodeableConceptDose form at package level (e.g. authorised dose form), corresponding to Combined Pharmaceutical Dose Form under the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) standards for the Identification of Medicinal Products (IDMP). This includes terms from EDQM Combination Pack or combined dose form lists. Dose form for a single package item is defined in item.doseForm.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: EDQM Standard Terms
EHDSMedication.description 0..1stringTextual description of the product, e.g. including package description.
EHDSMedication.item 0..*BaseA medication item. For combination packs, this may be multiple manufactured items with each item having its own dose form and ingredients + strengths defined.
EHDSMedication.item.doseForm 0..1CodeableConceptAdministrable or manufactured item dose form, depending on the type of medication definition. This shall not include combined dose forms.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: EDQM Standard Terms
EHDSMedication.item.ingredient 0..*BaseIngredients.
EHDSMedication.item.ingredient.isActive 0..1booleanMarks whether the substance is considered an active substance. Excipients are typically not needed, and by default only active ingredients are required.
EHDSMedication.item.ingredient.substance 1..1CodeableConceptSubstance.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: EMA SPOR SMS
EHDSMedication.item.ingredient.strengthInfo 0..1BaseAmount of active substance per unit.
EHDSMedication.item.ingredient.strengthInfo.strength[x] 1..1Concentration or presentation strength, e.g ‘100 mg/1 ml’ or ‘500 mg per tablet’.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: UCUM for units of measure / EDQM Standard Terms for units of presentation
EHDSMedication.item.ingredient.strengthInfo.strength[x].strengthRatioRatio
EHDSMedication.item.ingredient.strengthInfo.strength[x].strengthStringstring
EHDSMedication.item.ingredient.strengthInfo.basisOfStrengthSubstance 0..1CodeableConceptActive substance that the strength refers to, especially when different from item strength substance.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: EMA SPOR SMS
EHDSMedication.item.unitOfPresentation 0..1CodeableConceptUnit of presentation for the medicinal product (tablet, vial, tube). Typically, the smallest countable object in the package.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: EDQM Standard Terms for units of presentation
EHDSMedication.item.containedQuantity 0..1RatioPackaged item quantity per item (3 ml / one vial)
EHDSMedication.item.containedQuantity.numerator 0..1QuantityNumerator value
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: UCUM for units of measure / EDQM Standard Terms for units of presentation
EHDSMedication.item.containedQuantity.denominator 0..1SimpleQuantity(5.0.0)Denominator value
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: UCUM for units of measure / EDQM Standard Terms for units of presentation
EHDSMedication.item.amount 0..1QuantityNumber of such items in this medicinal product (e.g. five vials in the package). The combined amount of all items shall be considered to be the total package size.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: UCUM for units of measure / EDQM Standard Terms for units of presentation
EHDSMedication.item.packageType 0..1CodeableConceptType of package of the medicinal product item.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: EDQM Standard Terms for packaging
EHDSMedication.device 0..*BaseAdministration device included in the medicinal product. Devices that are not inside the package of the medicinal product are excluded.
EHDSMedication.device.deviceQuantity 1..1integerNumber of devices.
EHDSMedication.device.device 1..1CodeableConceptDevice coded.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: EDQM Standard Terms
EHDSMedication.characteristic 0..*BaseAdditional features of the medicinal product (e.g. reimbursable, sugar-free, easy-open cap, score-lined). Implementers shall define a value set supporting their use cases.
EHDSMedication.characteristic.type 1..1CodeableConceptA code expressing the type of characteristic.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: Not defined
EHDSMedication.characteristic.value[x] 0..1Description of the characteristic value.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: UCUM for units of measure
EHDSMedication.characteristic.value[x].valueBooleanboolean
EHDSMedication.characteristic.value[x].valueCodeableConceptCodeableConcept
EHDSMedication.characteristic.value[x].valueStringstring
EHDSMedication.characteristic.value[x].valueQuantityQuantity
EHDSMedication.characteristic.value[x].valueDateTimedateTime
EHDSMedication.characteristic.value[x].valueIntegerinteger
EHDSMedication.characteristic.value[x].valueDecimaldecimal
EHDSMedication.characteristic.value[x].valueRatioRatio
EHDSMedication.batch 0..1BaseBatch information of a medicinal product. Typically recorded during dispensation or administration, rarely known or relevant for a prescription/request.
EHDSMedication.batch.lotNumber 0..1stringBatch identifier of the medicinal product.
EHDSMedication.batch.expirationDate 0..1dateTimeBatch expiry date of the medicinal product.
